rule.statistic: the registered arm minus C against chain 37 and against chain 46, decisive-Elo, 95% seed-cluster intervals
rule.Unread: a contrast or an end of its interval is missing or not finite
rule.Negative: either interval entirely below zero (upper end below 0)
rule.Positive: both point estimates at +15 or more and both intervals entirely above zero (lower end above 0)
rule.Flat: both intervals inside -15 to +15, ends included

note: the label is the registered arm's; the other arms' contrasts are a descriptive dose-response and carry none
